name: Baito e Ikou!
source:
You as main character, gets a winter vacation that you will not forget. Living somewhere on the world, with your parents on vacation, a period of appx 2 weeks of solitude is given to you. During this time you will be able to roam around your area and meet new girls. 

[From [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=425&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演的主人公将度过一个永生难忘的寒假。你生活在世界某处，父母外出度假，因此获得了大约两周的独处时光。在此期间，你可以在附近自由活动，结识新的女孩。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=425&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
